summative_rubric.title: Loop the Loop — Summative Rubric

rows.expectation_text: solve problems and create computational representations of mathematical situations by writing and executing code, including code that involves sequential events

levels.descriptor: Writes 5+ step ordered code with at least one loop.
Writes complex code with multiple loops; executes correctly.

rows.expectation_text: read and alter existing code, including code that involves sequential events, and describe how changes to the code affect the outcomes

levels.descriptor: Cannot read code or predict outcomes.
Predicts simple sequential outcomes with prompts.
Predicts outcomes for code with loops; alters code and predicts the new outcome.
Articulates how alterations affect outcomes; identifies invariant alterations.

summative_rubric.usage_notes: Apply this rubric to combined evidence.
summative_rubric.layout_description: One letter page, landscape. 5-column grid with 2 rows.

summative_task_script.title: Lesson 5 Summative Task — My Code Project
administration_steps: Walk through the Capstone Code Template.
summative_task_script.scoring_guidance: Project coherence (out of 3) + sequence + loop usage (out of 4) + correct prediction (out of 3) = 10.

evidence_per_expectation.C3.1: Code includes ordered sequence and at least 1 loop.
evidence_per_expectation.C3.2: Prediction matches the code; verification shows understanding.
